crossRefs.note: David said, “Whoever strikes the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain.” Joab the son of Zeruiah went up first…
Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the army, Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder,
Elihoreph and Ahijah, the sons of Shisha, scribes; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, the recorder;

parallels.note: Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the army, Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder,
Adoram was over the men subject to forced labor, Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was the recorder,

people.name: Ahilud
people.line: Father of Jehoshaphat and Baana, officials under David and Solomon

people.name: Joab
people.line: Son of Zeruiah, commander of David's army

people.name: Zeruiah
people.line: Sister of David; mother of Joab, Abishai, and Asahel
